0022600153.text: The Houston Rockets (5-1) host the Oklahoma City Thunder (4-1) in their seventh game of the season, with Houston 2-0 at home and coming off a loss after winning five of their last six. Houston is missing Fred VanVleet (knee), Reed Sheppard (back), and Steven Adams (calf strain), while Oklahoma City is without Alex Caruso (ankle), Cason Wallace (shoulder, surgery), Chet Holmgren (knee), Jalen Williams (leg fracture), Nikola Topic (back), and Thomas Sorber (knee). The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and in 2025-26 the Rockets lost the season series 1-2, though Houston won the most recent meeting 112-106 in Oklahoma City on February 7.
